ALL IN: COMEDY ABOUT LOVE was written by Simon Rich and starred John Mulaney, Richard Kind, Fred Armisen, and Chloe Fineman. Simon Rich has a new show on Broadway – a sequel to ALL IN called ALL OUT: COMEDY ABOUT AMBITION. It runs through March 8 at the Nederlander Theatre.

acts.desc:
Writer Etgar Keret reads his story about a bus driver who refuses to open the doors for late passengers.
This story is from Etgar's book, The Bus Driver Who Wanted To Be God & Other Stories. Etgar sends stories and poems to subscribers in his newsletter, Alphabet Soup.
